verdict.rationale: The founder's own description says Zero auto-categorizes email, summarizes threads, and lets users chat with their inbox (zero-comm-1). The MCP docs expose label tools (create custom labels, modify labels, filter by labels) and mailbox Q&A, which an external agent could use for labeling-based triage (zero-docs-1, zero-docs-3, zero-docs-13, zero-docs-9). However, the evidence only describes these capabilities and never documents how automatic triage actually works. missing for 10: first-party docs of automatic categorization/labeling behavior, prioritization or surfacing of what needs attention, user controls to steer triage rules, audit trail or explanations of AI triage decisions, independent hands-on corroboration.
